knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Load Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)
library(knitr)
```

# 1. Load Raw Data

```{r}
# Load WITHOUT removing missing values first
data_raw <- read.csv("../data/raw/StudentPerformanceFactors.csv", 
                     stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

cat("Raw data dimensions:", nrow(data_raw), "rows,", ncol(data_raw), "columns\n")
```

# 2. Missing Data Analysis

## 2.1 Missing Values Summary

```{r}
# Check for NAs and empty strings
missing_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(data_raw),
  NA_Count = colSums(is.na(data_raw)),
  Empty_String_Count = colSums(data_raw == "", na.rm = TRUE),
  Total_Missing = colSums(is.na(data_raw)) + colSums(data_raw == "", na.rm = TRUE),
  Percent_Missing = round(100 * (colSums(is.na(data_raw)) + colSums(data_raw == "", na.rm = TRUE)) / nrow(data_raw), 2)
)

# Show only variables with missing data
missing_summary_nonzero <- missing_summary %>%
  filter(Total_Missing > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Missing))

kable(missing_summary_nonzero, 
      caption = "Variables with Missing Data")
```

## 2.2 Total Missing Data

```{r}
total_missing <- sum(missing_summary$Total_Missing)
total_cells <- nrow(data_raw) * ncol(data_raw)

cat("Total missing values:", total_missing, "\n")
cat("Overall missing percentage:", round(100 * total_missing / total_cells, 2), "%\n")

rows_with_missing <- sum(rowSums(is.na(data_raw) | data_raw == "") > 0)
cat("\nRows with missing:", rows_with_missing, 
    "(", round(100 * rows_with_missing / nrow(data_raw), 2), "%)\n")
```

# 3. Clean Data

```{r}
# Convert empty strings to NA
data_raw[data_raw == ""] <- NA

# Remove rows with missing values
data <- na.omit(data_raw)

cat("\n=== CLEANING SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Before: ", nrow(data_raw), "rows\n")
cat("After:  ", nrow(data), "rows\n")
cat("Removed:", nrow(data_raw) - nrow(data), "rows\n")
```

# 4. Target Variable

```{r}
summary(data$Exam_Score)

ggplot(data, aes(x = Exam_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Exam Scores")
```

# 5. Key Relationships

## Hours Studied

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Hours_Studied, y = Exam_Score)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  theme_minimal()

cat("Correlation:", round(cor(data$Hours_Studied, data$Exam_Score), 3))
```

## Attendance

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Attendance, y = Exam_Score)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  theme_minimal()

cat("Correlation:", round(cor(data$Attendance, data$Exam_Score), 3))
```

## Motivation Level

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = Motivation_Level, y = Exam_Score, fill = Motivation_Level)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal()

data %>%
  group_by(Motivation_Level) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), Mean = mean(Exam_Score)) %>%
  kable()
```

# 6. Correlation Matrix

```{r}
numeric_vars <- data %>% select_if(is.numeric)
cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_vars)
corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "upper")
```

# Summary

Clean data: `r nrow(data)` observations ready for modeling!
